title: Activity refresh client
responsibility: Refreshes site activity while a browser page is visible and reports missing readings.

inputs.name: activityClient.arrived
inputs.description: Callback that receives the response body parsed with response.json() and cast to Shown (from src/workflows/runActivity) with no runtime check, and it runs only for an ok response while the client is active. If it throws, the exception goes to the same catch as request failures, which calls missed while the client is still active.

inputs.name: activityClient.missed
inputs.description: Callback called from the catch of a refresh while the client is active, for a rejected fetch, a non-ok HTTP status, a body that cannot be parsed as JSON, or an exception thrown by arrived. It is not called after stop, including for a request that stop aborts, or for a refresh skipped because one is already pending, and an exception it throws is not caught, so the promise returned by refresh rejects.

outputs.name: activityClient
outputs.description: An object with refresh and stop methods; creating it reads document synchronously, so it needs a DOM document, and it sends no request on construction. refresh returns without fetching while a request is pending or after stop, otherwise fetching /api/project-activity with cache 'no-store' and not checking visibility itself; a 15-second timer and a visibilitychange listener call it only while document.visibilityState is 'visible', and stop clears the timer, removes the listener, marks the client inactive and aborts any in-flight request.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown inside refresh when the response status is not ok, with the message 'Activity unavailable.'; refresh catches it and calls missed while the client is active, so the methods returned by activityClient never reject with it.
